verdict.rationale: Graphite is a SaaS code-review and stacking platform, so data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no export feature for Graphite-held data such as Insights metrics, AI review rules, or chat history, and no open-format dump. Git compatibility and a community note that stack metadata lives in git refs are adjacent design traits, and code and PRs living on GitHub is a host-platform property, so neither counts as a Graphite export capability.
